description: Check which suppliers can likely serve a US business address, with honest status (likely | unknown | confirmed | not_available), the evidence source, and the price you are allowed to see. FCC BDC mass-market speeds are lower bounds, not business maximums or address-specific guarantees. FCC data only ever yields likely or unknown; pass confirm: true to ask suppliers for a binding answer.

address.description: US service address: one line ("2200 Ross Ave, Dallas, TX 75201") or structured

category.description: Limit the check to one category

confirm.description: Also ask each supplier to confirm; returns confirm_request_id per service

phone.description: Business phone number; used only for NPA-NXX (exchange) footprints

service_ids.description: Limit the check to these services (default: every in-scope service with an availability class)

name: availability.check
